subject: EdgePay deployment-path clarification and pilot next steps
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Khatri <samir@edgepay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Nov 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: EdgePay deployment-path clarification and pilot next steps

Thanks again for carving out time today — good conversation. Quick recap of what we heard on your side and the recommended next steps so we’re all aligned.

What we heard (key constraints)
- Latency: p95 target ~70ms for typical checkout flows (context ~256 tokens). Tail is important — spikes impact conversions.
- Throughput: steady-state ~800–1,200 QPS during business hours; spikes to ~2,500 QPS for promos (~10–15 min).
- Traffic mix: ~65% real-time checkout (low latency), ~35% async batch/reranking.
- Data & compliance: production data must remain in your VPC; sensitive logging retention restrictions.

Our read: a Dedicated capacity path is the safest production fit if the p95/steady QPS numbers are accurate — Dedicated gives predictable throughput, reserved GPU pools and priority scheduling to keep tail latency tight. Hosted API is viable for an initial trial or for async workloads, but sustaining 1k+ real-time QPS with 70ms p95 is where Dedicated starts to make sense. Private VPC/on-prem could be required later for stricter compliance, but not mandatory to start.

Proposed next steps (actionable)
1) Pilot plan (2 weeks): provision a Dedicated pool sized for your steady QPS + 2x burst headroom. We'll run synthetic and replay tests using the traces you shared. Deliverables: benchmark report (latency distribution), tuning recommendations (batching, KV caching, quant profiles). Attachment: EdgePay_SLA_matrix.xlsx (initial targets and options).
2) Data point request from your side: sample production trace (p95/p99 token sizes, request/response size distribution), confirmation of model size(s) (FP16/INT8), and any on-prem KMS requirements.
3) Commercial & procurement: we'll produce a pilot quote and a reserved-capacity term estimate once we agree on sizing.
4) Timeline: Can we kick the pilot the week of Nov 13? We need a procurement contact and PO cadence to lock a start.

Open questions for you
- Confirm: is 70ms p95 the hard requirement or a target we can iterate on?
- What percentage of requests must be served from within your VPC vs external?

I’ll follow up with a one-page pilot scope and a proposed Dedicated configuration. If you want to run a quick comparison benchmark on Hosted to validate the delta, we can schedule that for this week.

Thanks —
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
sergio@redwood.ai
(Attachment: EdgePay_SLA_matrix.xlsx)

From: Samir Khatri <samir@edgepay.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops+infra@edgepay.com
Date: Mon, 5 Nov 2028 11:03:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: EdgePay deployment-path clarification and pilot next steps

Thanks, Sergio — this matches our notes. A few clarifications from infra:
- 70ms p95 is the bar for the checkout experience team; p99 can be higher but we’d like to see p95 steady under 80ms during promos.
- Our steady-state target is 1k QPS; promo spikes have hit 2.4k in the last quarter.
- We can provide token-size distributions and tracer output; attaching a raw QPS trace now (edgepay_qps_trace.json).
- Procurement: we prefer a 30-day pilot PO. Will your pilot require us to sign any additional security paperwork?

We’re open to starting with Hosted for a quick comparison, but if Dedicated is materially better for p95 under load we’ll move there. Nov 13 start is possible.

Samir
Samir Khatri
Head of Infrastructure, EdgePay
samir@edgepay.com
(Attachment: edgepay_qps_trace.json)

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Khatri <samir@edgepay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 6 Nov 2028 08:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: EdgePay deployment-path clarification and pilot next steps

Appreciate the quick reply and the trace — that’s exactly what our bench team needs. A few follow-ups:

1) Security paperwork: we can run the pilot under our standard pilot agreement and an NDA addendum if you need it. If you require VPC-only access for the pilot we can scope a Private control-plane setup, but that adds ~1–2 weeks to provisioning. For the Nov 13 timeline I recommend Hosted comparison + Dedicated pilot where the Dedicated pool is in a customer-isolated project (network egress controls + KMS integration).

2) Proposed Dedicated configuration (initial recommendation based on your traces):
- Pool: 6 x L40s (or equivalent) with autoscale headroom and burst nodes for promo traffic.
- Runtime: INT8 with selective FP16 for sensitive prompts; KV prefix caching enabled for checkout templates.
- Expected deliverable: p95 target < 70–80ms at 1k steady QPS in our replay tests. 

3) Pilot scope & telemetry: 2-week run — week 1 synthetic + replay, week 2 canary with a small % of live traffic. We’ll provide: latency histograms (p50/p90/p95/p99), token-level cost breakdown, and a config playbook to hit the SLAs. Attachment: pilot_scope.md (scope & checkpoints).

If that config looks reasonable, I’ll ask Ben to size the formal quote and Marissa to coordinate bench availability. Can you confirm PO rubric and any mandatory security controls we need to include?

Best,
Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
(Attachment: pilot_scope.md)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 6 Nov 2028 14:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Internal: EdgePay pilot prep (bench & price)

Quick internal sync — tagging this thread for context. Action items: 
- Ben: please draft the pilot quote with the 6xL40 baseline + autoscale and include a Hosted fallback line item. Add a hidden note for a 90-day reserved-capacity discount option.
- Bench team: allocate a bench slot for Nov 14–21 for synthetic + replay runs; include INT8/FP16 toggles and cache-on/ cache-off permutations.
- Docs: include a short how-to for integrating KMS and VPC egress rules in the pilot scope.

Sergio — please capture confirmation from Samir on the PO size and whether the pilot must be VPC-only. If they insist on VPC-only, we’ll need to slide the start by ~10 business days.

Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
